name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ウマ娘 プリティーダービー トウカイテイオー
name.en: Figure-rise Standard Umamusume: Pretty Derby Tokai Teio

description.ja: 『ウマ娘プリティーダービー』トウカイテイオーがFigure-rise Standardで走りだす‼
description.en: “Uma Musume Pretty Derby” Tokai Teio starts running with Figure-rise Standard!!

description.ja: ■前傾姿勢で走る、ウマ娘ならではの疾走ポーズを再現。
description.en: • Reproduces the sprinting pose unique to Uma Musume, which runs with a forward leaning position.

description.ja: スカートは側面がスリット構造になっており、跳ね上げるように動かすことが可能。
description.en: The skirt has a slit structure on the side and can be flipped up.

description.ja: 重なったパーツが目隠しになり、シルエットを崩さずに前傾姿勢で走る姿が決まる。
description.en: The overlapping parts act as a blindfold, allowing you to lean forward while running without compromising your silhouette.

description.ja: ■特徴的なテイオーステップも再現可能。
description.en: • The characteristic Teio step can also be reproduced.

description.ja: ■弾ける笑顔と、元気いっぱいの動きも魅力的に演出。
description.en: • Her bright smile and energetic movements are also attractive.

description.ja: ■表情の異なる３種の顔パーツが付属。笑顔の瞳は「タンポ印刷」で再現。
description.en: • Three types of face parts with different expressions are included. The smiling eyes are reproduced with "tampo printing".

description.ja: 他の２種は水転写式デカールを採用。
description.en: The other two types use water transfer decals.

description.ja: ■１パーツ単位で構造を追求することにより、“勝負服”や頭部などが組み立てるだけでカラフルに仕上がる。
description.en: • By pursuing the structure of each part, "competition clothes" and heads can be made colorful just by assembling them.

description.ja: ■靴裏の蹄鉄はシールで再現。靴の前後をパーツ分けすることで、地面を蹴る姿もしなやかに表現。
description.en: • The horseshoes on the soles are reproduced with Seal. By separating the front and back parts of the shoe, it is possible to express the way he kicks the ground.

description.ja: ■頭部は、動きを付けられる耳やリボン、風になびいて抑揚のあるポニーテールを演出。
description.en: • The head features movable ears and ribbons, and a ponytail that flutters in the wind.

description.ja: ■左右で色の異なるハンドパーツが付属。右手は表情のある平手と合わせて合計６種類をセット。
description.en: • Hand parts with different colors on the left and right are included. There are a total of 6 types of right hands, including a palm with expressions.

description.ja: ■背中に支柱を接続し、クリア成形の台座でボディを保持。走る姿を演出する。
description.en: • Connect the post to the back and hold the body with a clear molded base. Produce the appearance of running.
